phase9_convnext_checkpoint_deployment_in.finding: The deployed application serves stage2 epoch-13 weights, while every published ConvNeXt metric describes the stage2 epoch-7 weights. The published metrics therefore do not describe the deployed model. The clinically relevant gap is -6.25 percentage points of cancer sensitivity at the deployed threshold (0.621528 -> 0.559028), while overall accuracy moves by only +0.4 points.
phase9_convnext_checkpoint_deployment_in.root_cause: config.CONVNEXT_CKPT points at the last epoch rather than at the best checkpoint; early stopping had already passed the best epoch (7) by epoch 13.
resolution_options: A (recommended): point CONVNEXT_CKPT at results/convnext_tiny/convnext_tiny_best.pt so the deployed model, the 0.525 threshold and the published metrics all agree. No retraining.
B: keep stage2_epoch13.pt and re-derive the threshold and all reported metrics against it.
C: re-train and export the best checkpoint as the deployment artifact.

step2_issue20.defect: The input-domain gate refused genuine lesion photographs and, at the same time, admitted ordinary photographs.
step2_issue20.evidence: A real corpus of 100 photographs was downloaded from Wikimedia Commons for this investigation: 30 genuine skin-lesion photographs and 70 ordinary photographs (5 each in poster, document, screenshot, classroom, building, scenery, furniture, book, electronics, animal, food, vehicle, selfie, body_photo). 156 synthetic stand-ins were tried first and none exceeded the 0.82 cut-off (max 0.8064) while real photographs reach 0.929, so synthetic images cannot exercise the region the rule change affects.
step2_issue20.root_cause: MobileNetV2 is a CANCER classifier, not a lesion-presence detector. Its probability is lower on genuine lesion photographs (median 0.074) than on ordinary photographs (median 0.123), so the rule 'refuse inside the ambiguous band when the second opinion is below 0.22' refused genuine lesions preferentially - 6 of the 8 genuine lesions inside the band, including two the deployed model itself calls highly malignant (probability 0.824 and 0.919).
step2_issue20.fix: the gate is decided by the distance to the HAM10000 manifold alone: analyse while score <= DOMAIN_BAND_SPLIT, refuse above it. DOMAIN_BAND_SPLIT = (DOMAIN_SUSPICIOUS_DISTANCE + DOMAIN_MAX_DISTANCE) / 2 = 0.76 is DERIVED from the two existing thresholds - no new tuned number. The MobileNetV2 second opinion is still computed for images near the boundary and reported as second_opinion_cancer_prob for auditing, but it can no longer refuse or admit an image.
step2_issue20.issue20_option_a_rejected: the fix originally proposed for ISSUE-20 (let the second opinion veto a refusal above 0.82) was implemented first and measured on the same 100 photographs: genuine lesions refused 23.3% (unchanged), ordinary photographs accepted 32.9% (worse than 17.1%), ordinary photographs reported as CANCER 4 (worse than 0). It was also unable to rescue the far lesions reliably - the genuine clinical skin-tumour photograph SkinTumors-P9280849.jpg (distance 0.8301) has a MobileNetV2 probability of 0.066 and is refused under option A too. Option A was therefore reverted.
